mods.name: socratic-mode
mods.description: For learning: answers a question with a short hint and one guiding question first, and gives the full answer when you ask. Code and commands stay exact.

mods.name: rubber-duck
mods.description: Restates the problem in its own words and lists its assumptions before it starts work.

mods.name: reviewer-mode
mods.description: After each code change, reviews its own diff like a strict senior reviewer and lists each issue it found and fixed.

mods.name: docstring-mode
mods.description: Every new or changed public function gets a short doc comment in the language's normal style.

mods.name: noir-mode
mods.description: Prose like a hard-boiled detective narrator, light and clear. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

mods.name: bullet-mode
mods.description: Replies as short bullet lists, at most one sentence per bullet, unless you ask for code.

mods.name: british-english
mods.description: British spelling and terms in prose (colour, organise, licence as a noun). Code identifiers stay as they are.

mods.name: mentor-pack
mods.description: Mentor habits in one install: a hint and a guiding question first, assumptions listed before work, and a strict self-review after each change.
